Launching a website isn't where the work has to end.

Solace website management covers hosting, security and backups, plus the small updates that come up all the time: hours, prices, menus, photos. You run the business. We take care of the website.

Bigger changes like redesigns or new pages get a separate quote first. Save this for when you're deciding who looks after your site.
